prompt: A papercraft pop-up diorama: a tiny world built from layered cut paper and folded cardstock, with crisp paper edges, subtle paper grain and soft shadows between layers, standing on a round paper base. In the diorama: A sunlit patch of grassy green hill slopes gently downward. At the center, two simple seated figures in casual morning clothes relax on a red-striped picnic blanket with a halved foil-wrapped burrito between them. Just in front, a scruffy tan dog happily guards an oversized bright neon-yellow tennis ball between his front paws. Two tall palm trees stand at the back right corner, while far in the background a tiny plastic disc hovers near distant tiny park-goers under clear morning light. Handmade, delicate and precise, like a pop-up book page come to life. The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Plain seamless off-white background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
